title: [SOLVED] Mumble notifications only appear once in KDE Plasma
body: I'm testing Mumble in Plasma and I noticed that the notifications only happen once until I restart Mumble. To test, I have a global hotkey set in Mumble for Mute Self, and the notification option enabled for "You self-muted." I open mumble, minimize, then hit the global hotkey. I see "You self-muted" pop up. I then wait for it to close after it times out (currently set to 2 seconds), and hit the hotkey again. No notification. After some testing I noticed that if I click X in the notification to close it, the next notification will work. The blockage only happens when I let it disappear by itself. It also works if I enable notification history under "Other Applications" in System Settings -> Notifications, then open the history and click the X to dismiss it. Though I don't want to have to manually dismiss the notification for subsequent ones to appear. I guess it's some quirk with how notifications work between Plasma and Mumble because it works fine in XFCE. Last edited by jmj (2026-10-26 17:29:43)
